meta_description:
205K likes, 1,134 comments - iamhumaq on October 4, 2026: "September left me with a lot of good memories.
Walking into October with an open heart.

From making it to the big screen to now finding its way into your homes. 🤍
Baby Do Die Do is now streaming on Netflix, for everyone to watch, share and hopefully find a little something of their own in it.

On the way to an evening I’ll remember for a long time.
Stepping into @televisionacad ✨

A reminder to stop and notice👀

There’s a different kind of feeling in wearing something that began as an idea in your own head. My first outing in @livefreefall 🤍

Dripping in diamonds and Piaget

A little pit stop, somewhere in LA, before the night carries on.

Ok bye, see you in October👋".
